exposure: Antibiotic administration prior to skin incision
Antibiotic administration after clamping of umbilical cord
outcome: Maternal infectious morbidities (fever, SSI, wound dehiscence, endometritis, UTI)
finding: Preoperative antibiotic administration significantly reduced maternal post-cesarean infectious morbidities compared to intraoperative administration, but there was no significant difference in neonatal outcomes.
